newsitem.title: USA: Oriole Homes Q4 new sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Oriole Homes Q4 new sales rise.

text.p: Oriole Homes Corp said on Friday it made 120 new sales contracts, valued at $18.67 million, during the fourth quarter, compared to 106 new sales contracts valued at $17.29 million in the same period last year.
The company said for 1996, it entered into new sales contracts valued at $110.12 million, or 670 units, compared to new contracts valued at $79.41 million or 483 units in 1995.
Sales of houses and condominiums closed during 1996 totaled $100.66 million, a 37 percent increase over 1995, Oriole said.
But the average value of sales closed during 1996 decreasd to $168,612 from $169,536, it said.

Oriole said the value of its backlog of undelivered housing, which reflects new sales contracts which have yet to close, increased 27 percent to $44.81 million as of December 31, 1996, from December 31, 1995.
